message.enhanced_vision.shader_error: Enhanced Vision shader could not load. See the log; F3+T retries.
enhanced_vision.config.enabled.tooltip: Enable the desktop lens and smooth sprint FOV, or the per-eye lens when Vivecraft VR is active. Default shortcut: F8.
enhanced_vision.config.strength.tooltip: Continuous peripheral expansion, shared by the desktop and VR lenses. Default: 0.15; 0 disables both lenses.
enhanced_vision.config.first_person_only: Desktop: first-person world only, without hands or HUD. VR: left/right eyes only, including world-space hands, guns and 3D HUD.
enhanced_vision.config.follow_fov.toolti: Desktop: reduce expansion below 70 degrees of world FOV. VR uses native eye projections; telescope and camera passes are excluded.
enhanced_vision.config.sprint_fov.toolti: Desktop only: smooth sprint world FOV, compatible with TACZ Disable Movement Attribute FOV. VR adds no sprint FOV.
enhanced_vision.config.sprint_strength.t: Default 0.1 means 10% more base world FOV while sprinting. Independent of the vanilla FOV Effects slider.
enhanced_vision.config.sprint_transition: Time to complete about 95% of the FOV change when starting or stopping sprinting. Default: 0.4 seconds.
fml.menu.mods.info.description.enhanced_:
Widen your peripheral view with smooth optical distortion while keeping the center steady.
Includes configurable sprint FOV transitions, TACZ compatibility and Vivecraft VR per-eye rendering.
Client-side only. Toggle with F8.
